independent_audit: Complete supplied 9-page main article and matched 14-page SI reviewed. Separate independent source, canonical/reader, reflection-table and molecular-binding audits passed. One synthesis route, three acquisition procedures and six analytical/model contexts retain their own sample identities. Average position/occupancy reconstruction is qualified separately; condition conflicts, two uncertain SI signs and unresolved physical sample links remain explicit. No exact ordered structure or training task is admitted.
publication_status: Source-reviewed contribution integrated; live deployment tracked separately.
training_note: No training task is admitted. The average position/occupancy CIF is a qualified source reconstruction, not an exact ordered structure or DFT-ready model.

gaps: The prose and Table 1 disagree on dehydration temperatures/durations and indium-contact duration. Neither version is selected as a resolved recipe.
Absolute host and indium amounts, capillary dimensions, feed-flow rate, indium/crystal temperature difference, redox vacuum, gas amount/flow, final vacuum and cooling rate are unreported.
Nominal Si100Al92 differs from the averaged Table 2 model containing 96 Si and 96 Al; fixed and varied occupancies are refinement parameters.
Average disorder, fractional site populations and charge-compensation hypotheses do not specify a unique atomistic specimen or a DFT-ready structure.

A curator reconstruction of the reported average positions and occupancies is qualified for source interpretation. It omits unresolved ADPs, preserves mixed and alternative sites, and is not a full refinement, ordered DFT model or exact-structure training label. Two SI signs remain unresolved.
The approximately 4300 Å XPS depth statement cannot be reconstructed from the displayed approximately 10 s sputter cycles and reported rate.
The input Na-X synthesis and cited control preparations are external references, not complete procedures supplied here.

notes: The prose and Table 1 disagree on dehydration temperatures/durations and indium-contact duration. Neither version is selected as a resolved recipe.
Absolute host and indium amounts, capillary dimensions, feed-flow rate, indium/crystal temperature difference, redox vacuum, gas amount/flow, final vacuum and cooling rate are unreported.
Nominal Si100Al92 differs from the averaged Table 2 model containing 96 Si and 96 Al; fixed and varied occupancies are refinement parameters.
Average disorder, fractional site populations and charge-compensation hypotheses do not specify a unique atomistic specimen or a DFT-ready structure.

CIF qualification is a separate pending gate. The SI aggregate passed its own audit with two unresolved signs; this canonical proposal does not convert reflection intensities into an exact structure or training label.
The approximately 4300 Å XPS depth statement cannot be reconstructed from the displayed approximately 10 s sputter cycles and reported rate.
The input Na-X synthesis and cited control preparations are external references, not complete procedures supplied here.

remaining_gaps: The prose and Table 1 disagree on dehydration temperatures/durations and indium-contact duration. Neither version is selected as a resolved recipe.
Absolute host and indium amounts, capillary dimensions, feed-flow rate, indium/crystal temperature difference, redox vacuum, gas amount/flow, final vacuum and cooling rate are unreported.
Nominal Si100Al92 differs from the averaged Table 2 model containing 96 Si and 96 Al; fixed and varied occupancies are refinement parameters.
Average disorder, fractional site populations and charge-compensation hypotheses do not specify a unique atomistic specimen or a DFT-ready structure.

A curator reconstruction of the reported average positions and occupancies is qualified for source interpretation. It omits unresolved ADPs, preserves mixed and alternative sites, and is not a full refinement, ordered DFT model or exact-structure training label. Two SI signs remain unresolved.
The approximately 4300 Å XPS depth statement cannot be reconstructed from the displayed approximately 10 s sputter cycles and reported rate.
The input Na-X synthesis and cited control preparations are external references, not complete procedures supplied here.

evidence_conflicts.description: The experimental prose gives both dehydration stages as 623 K for 48 h at 10⁻⁶ Torr, while Table 1 gives 673 K for 3 days. Indium contact is 96 h in the prose and 5 days in Table 1. These discrepancies remain unresolved within one study.
evidence_conflicts.disposition: preserve original evidence and withhold dependent training labels

evidence_conflicts.description: The nominal framework is Si100Al92, whereas the averaged Table 2 model corresponds to 96 Si and 96 Al. The two representations are preserved separately; neither composition is silently substituted for the other.
evidence_conflicts.disposition: preserve original evidence and withhold dependent training labels

evidence_conflicts.description: The proposed indium charge model provides 83 positive charges against 92 negative framework charges. Oxygen loss and proton compensation are hypotheses, not measured defects or atom positions.
evidence_conflicts.disposition: preserve original evidence and withhold dependent training labels

evidence_conflicts.description: Figure 1B reproduces a parent In87-X spectrum from reference 34. Figure 2A scales the indium-metal intensity to one twentieth. These references and display conventions remain distinct from current-product measurements.
evidence_conflicts.disposition: preserve original evidence and withhold dependent training labels

evidence_conflicts.description: The Figure 3 caption gives approximately 10 s sputter intervals at 0.6 Å/s, while the prose mentions an approximately 4300 Å depth. The displayed cycle sequence does not establish the full sputtering history.
evidence_conflicts.disposition: preserve original evidence and withhold dependent training labels

evidence_conflicts.description: The reported data/parameter ratios use the strong-reflection counts numerically, while the table heading and footnote define the numerator using all unique reflections. The printed ratios and both count definitions are retained.
evidence_conflicts.disposition: preserve original evidence and withhold dependent training labels

evidence_conflicts.description: One subsection heading refers to sites I′ and II′, while the body and final table place the minor In(IIa) population at site II. The exact atom labels are retained without silently correcting the heading.
evidence_conflicts.disposition: preserve original evidence and withhold dependent training labels
